verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a public API for programmatically accessing and acting on its data, including creating issues. It publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with 119 paths at api.usepylon.com, renders per-endpoint reference pages with a "Test it" runner, and its changelog shows new endpoints such as GET /task-statuses. The probe 404s for OpenAPI files on the docs domain don't contradict this, because the spec is hosted on the API origin. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API usage beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
Pylon publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at its API origin (info title "Pylon API.", 119 paths, US and EU server entries), downloadable as plain JSON with no auth wall.
Added a GET /task-statuses API endpoint for enumerating configured task statuses
